text: The **Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13) dataset** detected the 2021 tree-cover loss, mapping **81.3 ha** of loss within the asset. This was corroborated by the **JRC GFC2020** reference data, which agreed on **98%** of the event area. The **MGAP 2021 forest map** confirmed the area was planted forest (Pinus spp.). The detection met observability criteria, including a minimum event size of **0.5 ha** and annual monitoring (2001–2025). However, the dataset does not specify the cause (e.g., harvest, fire) or legality of the loss.
